title: Simulation 3D Sky Hogg Pack
text: Generate translation and rotation information for Sky Hogg, 12 inputs, 2 outputs, {Select input coordinate frame} sets Input coordinate frame; {Propeller rotation} sets the option to enable Propeller_R input port, {Rudder rotation} sets the option to enable Rudder_R input port, {Elevator rotation} sets the option to enable Elevator_R input port, {Left aileron rotation} sets the option to enable Left_Aileron_R input port, {Right aileron rotation} sets the option to enable Right_Aileron_R input, {Flaps rotation} sets the option to enable Flaps_R input port, {Nose wheel strut rotation} sets the option to enable Nose_Wheel_Strut_R input, {Nose wheel rotation} sets the option to enable Nose_Wheel_R input port, {Left wheel rotation} sets the option to enable Left_Wheel_R input port and {Right wheel rotation} sets the option to enable Right_Wheel_R input port. Values come from the instance.

params.values: Option to enable Propeller_R input port off (default) | on
